title: Proven Solution: Up to 50% Longer Tool Life for Foundation Drilling in Hard Rock
summary: Improve foundation drilling performance in hard rock with Kennametal shank conicals, shown to last up to 50% longer than competitor tools in demanding chert conditions.
body_markdown:
Unlike controlled laboratory evaluations,[foundation drilling](https://www.kennametal.com/us/en/products/construction/foundation-drilling.html) projects rarely allow for perfect side-by-side testing. Because of that, the drilling crew was understandably reluctant to remove functioning tools for evaluation purposes. To mitigate the disruption that would entail, Kennametal instead installed its shank conicals gradually as the competitor tools reached end of life.


The first Kennametal picks were placed on the outermost section of the core barrel, where the most aggressive cutting action takes place and the highest levels of wear and impact are felt. Initially, the wear appeared similar, but as drilling progressed and further competitor tools were replaced with Kennametal shank conicals, a notable trend emerged. The Kennametal tools continued cutting effectively while many competing conicals had already reached end of life.
